name: Banh goi
summary: Bánh gối is a pillow-shaped fried pastry, filled with minced pork, wood-ear or black fungus, and glass noodles, sometimes with a quail egg.
howToEat: The filling is minced pork, black fungus or wood-ear mushrooms, and vermicelli or glass noodles, sometimes with a quail egg.
Eat it in the afternoon with the other fried snacks, dipped in fish sauce and topped with mint.
seoDescription: Bánh gối in Hanoi is a fried pillow pastry of pork, wood ear, and glass noodles, sometimes with a quail egg, dipped in fish sauce with mint.
